profiles_verified_phone_key.name: profiles_verified_phone_key
profiles_verified_phone_key.where: phone_verified_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

spaces_published_requires_price.name: spaces_published_requires_price
spaces_published_requires_price.value: "spaces"."status" NOT IN ('published', 'rented') OR "spaces"."price_monthly_cents" IS NOT NULL

spaces_published_requires_location.name: spaces_published_requires_location
spaces_published_requires_location.value: "spaces"."status" <> 'published' OR ("spaces"."location" IS NOT NULL AND "spaces"."approx_location" IS NOT NULL)

spaces_published_requires_complete.name: spaces_published_requires_complete
spaces_published_requires_complete.value:
"spaces"."status" NOT IN ('published','rented') OR (
            "spaces"."city" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("spaces"."city")) > 0
            AND "spaces"."state" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("spaces"."state")) = 2
            AND "spaces"."district" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("spaces"."district")) > 0
            AND length(trim("spaces"."title")) >= 10
            AND "spaces"."description" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("spaces"."description")) >= 20
            AND "spaces"."available_from" IS NOT NULL
          )

bookings_access_audio_shape.name: bookings_access_audio_shape
bookings_access_audio_shape.value:
("bookings"."access_audio_path" IS NULL AND "bookings"."access_audio_duration_ms" IS NULL AND "bookings"."access_audio_mime" IS NULL)
          OR ("bookings"."access_audio_path" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."access_audio_duration_ms" BETWEEN 1000 AND 180000
              AND "bookings"."access_audio_mime" IS NOT NULL)

bookings_payment_window.name: bookings_payment_window
bookings_payment_window.value:
("bookings"."status" = 'past_due'
            AND "bookings"."payment_issue_started_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "bookings"."payment_issue_deadline_at" = "bookings"."payment_issue_started_at" + interval '120 minutes')
          OR ("bookings"."status" <> 'past_due' AND "bookings"."payment_issue_started_at" IS NULL AND "bookings"."payment_issue_deadline_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("bookings"."status" = 'ended' AND "bookings"."payment_issue_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."payment_issue_deadline_at" > "bookings"."payment_issue_started_at")

booking_deposits_release_amounts_consist.name: booking_deposits_release_amounts_consistent
booking_deposits_release_amounts_consist.value:
("booking_deposits"."release_status" = 'held' AND "booking_deposits"."released_cents" IS NULL AND "booking_deposits"."forfeited_cents" IS NULL)
          OR ("booking_deposits"."release_status" <> 'held' AND "booking_deposits"."released_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "booking_deposits"."forfeited_cents" IS NOT NULL
              AND "booking_deposits"."released_cents" + "booking_deposits"."forfeited_cents" = "booking_deposits"."amount_cents")

booking_deposits_release_status_matches_.name: booking_deposits_release_status_matches_split
booking_deposits_release_status_matches_.value:
"booking_deposits"."release_status" NOT IN ('released','forfeited','partially_forfeited')
          OR (
            ("booking_deposits"."release_status" = 'released' AND "booking_deposits"."forfeited_cents" = 0)
            OR ("booking_deposits"."release_status" = 'forfeited' AND "booking_deposits"."released_cents" = 0)
            OR ("booking_deposits"."release_status" = 'partially_forfeited' AND "booking_deposits"."released_cents" > 0 AND "booking_deposits"."forfeited_cents" > 0)
          )

payments_outbox_idx.name: payments_outbox_idx
payments_outbox_idx.where: (refund_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND status NOT IN ('refunded','partially_refunded')) OR (delete_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND provider_deleted_at IS NULL)

messages_flagged_idx.name: messages_flagged_idx
messages_flagged_idx.where: flagged_at IS NOT NULL AND hidden_at IS NULL

messages_audio_shape.name: messages_audio_shape
messages_audio_shape.value:
("messages"."kind"::text = 'text' AND "messages"."audio_path" IS NULL AND "messages"."audio_duration_ms" IS NULL AND "messages"."audio_mime" IS NULL)
          OR ("messages"."kind"::text = 'audio' AND "messages"."audio_path" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."audio_duration_ms" BETWEEN 1000 AND 180000
              AND "messages"."audio_mime" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."body" = '')

reports_one_open_per_target.name: reports_one_open_per_target
reports_one_open_per_target.where: status IN ('open','reviewing') AND reporter_id IS NOT NULL

reports_target_matches_type.name: reports_target_matches_type
reports_target_matches_type.value:
("reports"."target_type"::text = 'space'   AND "reports"."space_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."target_user_id" IS NULL AND "reports"."message_id" IS NULL AND "reports"."review_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("reports"."target_type"::text = 'user'    AND "reports"."target_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."space_id" IS NULL AND "reports"."message_id" IS NULL AND "reports"."review_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("reports"."target_type"::text = 'message' AND "reports"."message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."space_id" IS NULL AND "reports"."target_user_id" IS NULL AND "reports"."review_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("reports"."target_type"::text = 'review'  AND "reports"."review_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."space_id" IS NULL AND "reports"."target_user_id" IS NULL AND "reports"."message_id" IS NULL)

reports_no_self_report.name: reports_no_self_report
reports_no_self_report.value: "reports"."target_user_id" IS NULL OR "reports"."reporter_id" IS NULL OR "reports"."target_user_id" <> "reports"."reporter_id"

reviews_target_matches_kind.name: reviews_target_matches_kind
reviews_target_matches_kind.value:
("reviews"."kind" = 'renter_to_space' AND "reviews"."space_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reviews"."target_user_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("reviews"."kind" = 'owner_to_renter' AND "reviews"."target_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reviews"."space_id" IS NULL)

sqa_classification_matches_score.name: sqa_classification_matches_score
sqa_classification_matches_score.value:
("space_quality_assessments"."classification" = 'economico'   AND "space_quality_assessments"."final_score" >= 0 AND "space_quality_assessments"."final_score" < 4)
       OR ("space_quality_assessments"."classification" = 'medio'       AND "space_quality_assessments"."final_score" >= 4 AND "space_quality_assessments"."final_score" < 7)
       OR ("space_quality_assessments"."classification" = 'alto_padrao' AND "space_quality_assessments"."final_score" >= 7 AND "space_quality_assessments"."final_score" < 9)
       OR ("space_quality_assessments"."classification" = 'luxo'        AND "space_quality_assessments"."final_score" >= 9 AND "space_quality_assessments"."final_score" <= 10)

sqa_price_columns_null_together.name: sqa_price_columns_null_together
sqa_price_columns_null_together.value:
("space_quality_assessments"."price_base_cents" IS NULL AND "space_quality_assessments"."price_score_factor_bps" IS NULL AND "space_quality_assessments"."price_extras_factor_bps" IS NULL
           AND "space_quality_assessments"."suggested_price_ideal_cents" IS NULL AND "space_quality_assessments"."suggested_price_min_cents" IS NULL AND "space_quality_assessments"."suggested_price_max_cents" IS NULL)
       OR ("space_quality_assessments"."price_base_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "space_quality_assessments"."price_score_factor_bps" IS NOT NULL AND "space_quality_assessments"."price_extras_factor_bps" IS NOT NULL
           AND "space_quality_assessments"."suggested_price_ideal_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "space_quality_assessments"."suggested_price_min_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "space_quality_assessments"."suggested_price_max_cents" IS NOT NULL)

sqa_price_score_factor_matches_classific.name: sqa_price_score_factor_matches_classification
sqa_price_score_factor_matches_classific.value:
"space_quality_assessments"."price_score_factor_bps" IS NULL OR "space_quality_assessments"."price_score_factor_bps" = CASE "space_quality_assessments"."classification"
            WHEN 'economico' THEN 7000 WHEN 'medio' THEN 10000 WHEN 'alto_padrao' THEN 12000 WHEN 'luxo' THEN 15000 END

sqa_price_market_warning_matches.name: sqa_price_market_warning_matches
sqa_price_market_warning_matches.value:
"space_quality_assessments"."price_market_warning" IS NULL OR (
            "space_quality_assessments"."suggested_price_ideal_cents" IS NOT NULL AND (
              ("space_quality_assessments"."price_market_warning" = 'acima_da_media'  AND "space_quality_assessments"."suggested_price_ideal_cents"::bigint * 10000 > "space_quality_assessments"."price_base_cents"::bigint * 15000)
              OR
              ("space_quality_assessments"."price_market_warning" = 'abaixo_da_media' AND "space_quality_assessments"."suggested_price_ideal_cents"::bigint * 10000 < "space_quality_assessments"."price_base_cents"::bigint * 7000)
            )
          )

waitlist_entries_status_dates.name: waitlist_entries_status_dates
waitlist_entries_status_dates.value:
("waitlist_entries"."status" = 'left') = ("waitlist_entries"."left_at" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("waitlist_entries"."status" = 'notified') = ("waitlist_entries"."notified_at" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("waitlist_entries"."status" = 'closed') = ("waitlist_entries"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
